title: お茶を濁す
meaning: to avoid giving a direct answer
meaning_example: 本音を見せず、お茶を濁した。He beat around the bush and avoided showing his true feelings.//もちろん人それぞれだからと慌てて茶を濁し、話題をすり替えた。She hurriedly made up some excuse about there being all types of people and changed the subject.

meaning_notes.text: 直接答えないで、曖昧に言えること
meaning_notes.html: 直接答えないで、曖昧に言えること
